notes:
Passed on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware, AirSim or JSBSim run was made. The upstream class is an old-style gym.Env with no gym.register call, so env_id is left unset and the bridge's gymnasium.make backend is not offered; the fake is a protocol stand-in for SingleObservation. The upstream environment itself cannot be opened here: it needs separate AirSim and JSBSim installs (README.md:6-10) and its FDM root is the hardcoded Windows path of src/jsbsim_simulator.py:76. The fake observation is a 3x8x8 placeholder. The real observation is the AirSim Scene image reshaped to (3, image_response.height, image_response.width) at src/image_processing.py:49; the clone fixes no default resolution for SingleObservation, so the runtime height and width cannot be named from the repository. The only explicit resolution in the clone is 480x832 in src/segmentation/config.py:22-23, which belongs to the separate segmentation pipeline, not to this environment. The fake's airport collision on step 50 is invented test data marked # placeholder, not an upstream schedule. The environment code has no time limit: max_updates is computed but step never compares id with it, so termination is the AirSim collision flag only and truncated is always false. reset is a full reinitialise; the seed is stored and echoed but does not change the initial state because reset loads basic_ic.xml. SingleObservation.reset() takes no arguments (src/envs/single_observation.py:115), so the bridge's reset options input is accepted but has no effect, and a seeded reset uses the bridge's legacy env.seed() then env.reset() fallback. Snapshot/restore is not offered (no get_state/set_state). Five warnings are expected: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the next-reset seed without a native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer seed inputs, ticks and the action.values[*] array (the bridge attaches no unit to the environment's action space; the upstream action is heading and pitch in degrees). Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. The clone stayed unmodified at c5054486fb05dc67668b123c7789e399c8d4ce02. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
